answer: Start each new identity on a separate mesa market, cut off from the main economy. There it earns credit only by finishing verified jobs for strangers, and that credit cannot be sold, lent, or shared between identities. Crossing the bridge to the main market burns the credit and writes the crossing into a ferrous ledger that rejects any second crossing from the same earned history. A faker wanting ten identities must do ten separate bodies of verified work, because no toll, history, or crossing can be reused.
